title: A small link in a web
hook: A tiny animal can connect different food sources.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The arrows connect microscopic algae to krill and krill to a whale in this stated example. Real food webs contain many other feeding relationships; not every whale eats krill.

misconception: A small animal cannot connect microscopic food to a much larger predator.
objective: In this simplified Antarctic food chain, which organism links microscopic algae to the whale?

claims.text: A tiny animal can connect different food sources. In this simplified Antarctic food chain, which organism links microscopic algae to the whale? claims.text: Recall: A tiny crustacean eats algae and is eaten by a whale. What role does the crustacean have in this toy web? The crustacean connects its algal food to a larger predator in this stated chain.
